source.repoNote: Provenance only; nothing reads this block. Every folder named below was checked against both trees on the date above; `node index.cjs check-map` re-checks them against whatever checkout it is pointed at.

_why: Which automation folders a changed ERP folder reaches is a fact about two repositories, not a judgement, so it is written down once instead of re-derived by a session on every ticket. `e2e` names cypress/e2e module folders: every spec in them becomes a candidate. `pages` names cypress/Pages folders (prefixes, so `teamManagement/jobRequisition` is one subfolder): they scope a GENERIC testid - one that page objects in three or more Pages folders select, like `submit-button`, or that the testIds files of two or more ERP folders define, like `add-task-button` (project_logs and the old kanban_board) - to the screens this area actually renders, so a rewards change that touches a submit button does not pull every forms and leaves spec in with it. A SPECIFIC testid matches page objects anywhere, which is how a change in a folder with no module of its own (settings/emailTemplates) still finds the two podA specs that drive it.
_why_keys: Frontend keys are paths under frontend/src/components, backend keys are app names under apps/. The longest key that prefixes a changed path wins, so `management/competency` and `management/leaves` split a folder whose halves belong to different modules.

header._why: The top bar every screen carries. No module owns it; profileA/profileB and home reach it through topNavBar page objects, which a testid match finds without pulling a module in.

job_requisition._why: jobRequisition specs import their page objects from teamManagement/jobRequisition and pod/jobRequisitions; there is no Pages/jobRequisition.

advisory._why: Architecture and progress advisory render inside Team Review (Pages/teamReview/advisory_*).

payroll._why: The allowance models live in apps/payroll/models.py; there is no apps/allowance.

shared._why: Code every module renders or imports. A change here maps to no module - mapping it to all of them would be the whole 800-spec suite - so specs come from testid matches alone, and a generic testid is allowed to match anywhere because a shared component really is on every screen. apps/core holds the person, increment and final-settlement code, apps/users holds resignations and mood: a backend change there needs the session to name the module from the diff. Files outside frontend/src/components (common/, jss/, routes.js) and files directly under it (App.js) are shared the same way without being listed.

uncovered._why: No cypress/e2e module drives these. Pages/analytics exists but no spec imports it; announcements and event_widget are the app-level banner and countdown, not Home's Announcements card (Pages/home/announcements.ts selects home's own testids). A change here is a coverage gap unless a specific testid match finds a spec anyway - settings/emailTemplates is reached by two podA specs exactly that way.

_why_ignore: Unit tests change no screen. apps/expenses/tests/* in a backend fix still leaves apps/expenses mapped through the code beside it; a diff of tests alone maps to nothing, which is the right answer.
